entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser enforces clamp's three-argument signature. lowerClamp forwards the original parsed call from lowerCall; lowerMathCall reaches this shared kernel only for the clamp family, and its direct mixed-root adapter additionally checks the call's arity in mathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp. Neither path rewrites the argument slice, so a parsed clamp cannot reach this arity guard.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The ordinary caller lowerClamp is selected by lowerCall only for clamp, clamp_min, or clamp_max. The shared dispatcher lowerMathCall invokes this kernel only from its explicit case for those same three names; its mixed-root input is checked by mathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp. All three names are handled by the switch above, so the trailing unknown-function error requires an internally fabricated call, not a parsed query.

guard: past exhaustive switch c.Func.Name over [case "clamp_max", "clamp_min"; case "clamp"]

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser enforces the two-argument signatures of clamp_min and clamp_max. lowerClamp forwards the original parsed call from lowerCall, while the shared dispatcher lowerMathCall and its direct-root recognizer mathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp preserve that call and validate this family's arity. Neither route changes the argument slice, so the two-argument guard cannot fail for a parsed query.
